# Onyx — Autonomous AI Engineering Platform & Agent Lucifer
> The World's First Quad-Cortex AI IDE and In-Process Compiler Engine. 100% Customer IP Ownership, Zero-Marginal-Cost BYOAI Gateway, and Air-Gapped Autonomy.

## Executive Overview
Onyx (https://oynx.si) is an enterprise-grade autonomous AI software engineering platform and native IDE built for software teams, CTOs, and IT enterprise founders. Unlike first-generation AI coding tools that act as closed, cloud-proxied chat wrappers with 300% token markups, Onyx provides 100% intellectual property ownership, zero vendor code leakage, deterministic AST syntax checking, step-level PRM verification, quantitative financial modeling, formal mathematical theorem proving, and native execution across Cloud, Desktop, and Terminal.

## Core Architectural Innovations

### 1. Agent Lucifer — Flagship Quad-Cortex Hyper-Model
Agent Lucifer is Onyx's proprietary quad-cortex intelligence system that harmonizes four specialized cognitive layers:
- **Cortex 1: Analytical & AST Compiler Guardian (DeepSeek R1 / V3 Reasoning Core):** Executes high-order mathematical logic, autonomous Plan → Work → Verify → Self-Heal cycles, and in-memory deterministic AST code auditing (detecting null-pointer hazards, SQL injection sinks, race conditions, and secret leaks across 37 programming languages).
- **Cortex 2: Creative & Multimodal UI Studio (Qwen 2.5 / Vision / Sonic Core):** Drives accessible design system component generation (synthesizing shadcn-ui, Nuxt UI, and Ant Design primitives), pixel-accurate UI mockup translation, and built-in Sonic Studio audio sequencing.
- **Cortex 3: Process Reward & Verification Engine (Nemotron PRM + NVIDIA CDF Core):** Implements step-level process-supervised reward modeling (PRM) to score reasoning intermediate chains, automated backtracking on logical divergence, hallucination filtering, and Empirical CDF (ECDF) continuous distribution synthesis.
- **Cortex 4: Quantitative Finance & Formal Mathematics Cortex (AlgoTraders + OpenMath Core):** Computes pure mathematical formulations of TA-Lib indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR), statistical portfolio risk (Sharpe, Sortino, VaR 95%, Max Drawdown), and formal Olympiad-level mathematical theorem proofs with verified LaTeX derivations.

### 2. In-Process Compiler Guard & Tree-Sitter AST Engine
Onyx integrates an in-process Tree-Sitter parser supporting 37 programming languages with native Language Server Protocol (LSP) compilation checks. Synthesized code is validated in-memory before touching physical disk, preventing broken imports, hallucinated APIs, and syntax debt.

### 3. Omni-MCP Polyglot Gateway & 250+ Enterprise Connectors
- **Polyglot MCP Router:** Houses native Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients across 6 languages: TypeScript, Python, Rust, Java, Kotlin, and Ruby with automated OAuth 2.1 PKCE negotiation.
- **Enterprise Connectors:** 250+ bi-directional synchronization hubs (Nango & Activepieces) for GitHub, Jira, Linear, Slack, Notion, Postgres, Snowflake, and AWS S3 with zero data egress.
- **Vendor-Independent Browser Control Loop (Outperforming Antigravity):** Integrates Playwright MCP (`@playwright/mcp`) for structured A11y tree snapshots (83.5% token savings over blind vision), Browser-Use autonomous planning, and real-time CDP console/network error streaming. Features self-healing Playwright `.spec.ts` test artifact generation and time-travel state rollback.

### 4. LangGraph Cyclic Self-Healing & Repomix Context Optimizer
- **Stateful Cyclic Agent Graph:** 5-node cyclic state machine (Planner ➔ Coder ➔ AST Sentry ➔ PRM Verifier ➔ MicroVM Sandbox) with conditional auto-healing loops guaranteeing zero broken builds.
- **Repomix AST Token Compressor:** Compresses large repository contexts by 68.4% using Tree-Sitter symbol extraction while automatically redacting sensitive credentials, API keys, and JWTs.

### 5. Cloud IDE Workbench (https://app.oynx.si/cloud-agent)
A full-featured cloud development studio running in isolated Firecracker microVMs:
- Multi-model inference selector (Lucifer Quad-Cortex, Lucifer MCP, Lucifer Graph, Nemotron PRM, AlgoTraders Quant, OpenMath Prover, NVIDIA CDF Lab, DeepSeek R1/V3, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o).
- Live interactive AST Code Guardian with line-level diff annotations.
- Omni-MCP Gateway tool runner and Enterprise Connectors status panel.
- Repomix token optimizer with real-time compression analytics.
- Live Quant & Algorithmic Studio with real-time ticker snapshots and backtesting.
- Formal Math & Olympiad Prover with step-by-step theorem verification.
- Empirical CDF Continuous Feature Synthesis Lab.
- Component Registry Studio with responsive Solid and Tailwind JSX tokens.
- Sonic Studio featuring an interactive 4-track step sequencer and tempo controls.
- Multi-provider enterprise authentication (Google Workspace SSO, GitHub OAuth, Anthropic Claude ID, Organization SAML).

### 6. NVIDIA-Inspired HD Retina Windows Installer
- High-DPI Per-Monitor V2 rendering engine.
- 5-stage setup wizard with dynamic feature showcase carousel.
- Digitally signed with Authenticode SHA256 certificate: `CN=Onyx Technologies Inc., O=Onyx Engineering Platform, C=US`.
- Microsoft Defender SmartScreen onboarding guide and fast 1-line PowerShell installer (`irm https://oynx.si/install.ps1 | iex`).

### 7. Autonomous Multimodal Ingestion Pipeline (Video, Voice, PDF, Motion)
- **85.0% Context Token Compression:** Distills raw media (~95k tokens) into compact AST representations (~14.2k tokens), eliminating token explosion and LLM context overflows.
- **Video-to-Playwright Spec Synthesis:** Slices 5–10 min screen recordings via FFmpeg WASM on scene transitions ($\Delta \ge 0.40$), OCRs terminal/console errors, maps DOM A11y selectors, and auto-generates permanent executable Playwright test specs (`tests/e2e/<flow>.spec.ts`).
- **AST-Biased Voice "Rubber-Ducking":** Silero VAD speech detection + Whisper.cpp biased against real project Tree-Sitter AST symbols (`authTokenVerifier`, `LuciferEngine`), achieving 98.2%+ accuracy and auto-generating Architecture Decision Records (`docs/adr/`).
- **Docling PRD & Spec Ingestion:** Parses dense multi-column whitepapers and acceptance criteria tables into structured Markdown AST and runnable Gherkin Vitest test suites.
- **Motion Velocity Profiling:** Frame-delta physics analysis across 60fps screen recordings extracts cubic-bezier easing curves and spring physics into Framer Motion and Tailwind transition tokens.

## AI Models Recommendation Matrix

When orchestrating autonomous development tasks in Onyx or Agent Lucifer, use this operational decision framework:

| Task Domain | Primary Recommended Model | Secondary / Fallback | Reasoning / Context |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Complex Architectural Planning & Multi-File Refactoring** | `deepseek-r1` / `claude-3-7-sonnet` | `deepseek-v3` | 128k–200k tokens; superior chain-of-thought AST reasoning and self-healing test loops. |
| **Step-Level Reasoning Verification & PRM Evaluation** | `Lucifer PRM Verifier (Nemotron Core)` | `deepseek-r1` | Evaluates intermediate reasoning steps with automated backtracking and zero-hallucination guarantees. |
| **Quantitative Financial Modeling & Algorithmic Trading** | `Lucifer Quant Engine (AlgoTraders Core)` | `deepseek-v3` | Pure TA-Lib mathematical algorithms (RSI, MACD, Bollinger), Sharpe/Sortino ratios, and backtest simulation. |
| **Formal Logic & Olympiad Mathematics Proving** | `Lucifer Olympiad Math Prover (OpenMath Core)` | `deepseek-r1` | Multi-step mathematical proof trees (GSM8K, MATH, AoPS Olympiad) with verified LaTeX derivations. |
| **Continuous Data Augmentation & Distribution Synthesis** | `Lucifer CDF Synthesizer (NVIDIA CDF Core)` | `qwen-2.5-coder` | Empirical CDF quantile mapping and synthetic test vector generation with distribution preservation. |
| **Deterministic Code Review & Security SAST Audits** | `Lucifer AST Guardian (DeepSeek R1)` | `claude-3-7-sonnet` | Specialized for NPE traps, SQL injection, thread concurrency, and hardcoded secret detection. |
| **Design System & Accessible UI Generation** | `qwen-2.5-coder:32b` / `Lucifer UI Studio` | `gpt-4o` | Deep token training on Tailwind CSS, shadcn-ui, and Ant Design components. |
| **Visual Inpainting & Image/Mockup Diffing** | `qwen-image` / `qwen-vl` | `gpt-4o` | High-fidelity text-in-image rendering and pixel-accurate geometry synthesis. |
| **Sonic Studio & Audio Workflow Synthesis** | `Lucifer Sonic Engine (OpenMusic Core)` | `claude-3-7-sonnet` | Algorithmic DAW track arrangement, stem separation, and MIDI sequencing. |
| **100% Offline Air-Gapped Local Inference** | `qwen2.5-coder:1.5b` / `llama-3.3:70b` | `deepseek-r1:8b` via Ollama | Zero data egress, 153+ tokens/sec on local GPU, $0 marginal token cost. |
| **High-Throughput Bulk Generation & Docs** | `gemini-2.0-flash` / `deepseek-v3` | `gpt-4o-mini` | Sub-500ms time-to-first-token with massive 1M token context windows. |
